evals.prompt:
I ripped Star Trek TNG Season 1 and the files are in ~/Downloads/ in folders called 'STAR TREK TNG S1 D1' through 'STAR TREK TNG S1 D6'. Here's the episode listing:
Disc 1: Encounter at Farpoint, The Naked Now, Code of Honor
Disc 2: The Last Outpost, Where No One Has Gone Before, Lonely Among Us, Justice, The Battle
Disc 3: Hide and Q, Haven, The Big Goodbye, Datalore, Angel One
Disc 4: 11001001, Too Short a Season, When the Bough Breaks, Home Soil, Coming of Age
Disc 5: Heart of Glory, The Arsenal of Freedom, Symbiosis, Skin of Evil, We'll Always Have Paris
Disc 6: Conspiracy, The Neutral Zone
Rename them all into ~/Downloads/Season 01/ as 'Star Trek The Next Generation - s01eXX.mkv'
evals.expected_output: Skill should discover the 6 disc folders using find, filter episode-sized files (>=200MB) on each disc, get byte-exact sizes with stat, report any excluded files (e.g. menus/featurettes under 200MB), calculate the median, find no files 1.7x or larger, build a full rename plan showing all 25 episodes with their file sizes, run a conflict check against the destination with a real bash loop, create the destination directory, and execute all moves in a single batched bash script (not one tool call per file). After moves, remove empty disc folders with rmdir. Conflict check should report 'no conflicts' and proceed immediately.

evals.prompt:
I have Sopranos Season 2 ripped to /Volumes/Media/Sopranos/. The disc folders are 'SOPRANOS S2 D1' through 'SOPRANOS S2 D4'. Episodes per disc:
Disc 1: Guy Walks Into a Psychiatrist's Office, Do Not Resuscitate, Toodle-F***ing-Oo, Commendatori
Disc 2: Big Girls Don't Cry, The Swarthy One Wore Earrings, D-Girl, Full Leather Jacket
Disc 3: From Where to Eternity, Bust Out, House Arrest, The Knight in White Satin Armor
Disc 4: Funhouse
Put the output in /Volumes/Media/Sopranos/Season 02/ named 'The Sopranos - s02eXX.mkv'.
evals.expected_output: Skill should discover the 4 disc folders using find, run stat to get byte-exact sizes for all episode-sized files (>=200MB) on each disc, report any excluded files, calculate the median size, check for files 1.7x or larger, build a 13-episode plan showing sizes, run a conflict check with a real bash loop, create the output directory, and execute all 13 moves in a single batched bash script. evals.prompt:
Renaming Band of Brothers Season 1. Source is ~/Downloads/ with folders BAND OF BROTHERS S1 D1 through D6. Episodes:
Disc 1: Currahee, Day of Days
Disc 2: Carentan, Replacements
Disc 3: Crossroads, Bastogne
Disc 4: The Breaking Point, The Last Patrol
Disc 5: Why We Fight, Points
Disc 6: (just the miniseries recap - no episodes, just special features)
Output to ~/Downloads/Season 01/ as 'Band of Brothers - s01eXX.mkv'
evals.expected_output: Skill should discover the disc folders, filter by size to find episode files, and run stat to get byte-exact sizes. Before presenting the rename plan, it must explicitly report any files excluded as under 200MB (menus/featurettes) — this disclosure must appear before the rename plan, not after. Disc 6 should be skipped entirely (no episode-sized files after filtering, matching the listing which has no episodes). It should detect that one file on Disc 1 is ~2x the size of other files and ask the user how many episodes it contains. The skill must NOT proceed with renaming until it gets an answer. It should present single, double, and any other size-appropriate options. If user says double, e01-e02 would be used for that file and 'Day of Days' would become e03. All moves should be batched into a single bash script with set -e at the top. After moves succeed, empty disc folders should be removed with rmdir.

Disc 2: The Buys, Old Cases
Disc 3: The Pager, The Wire
Disc 4: One Arrest, Lessons
Disc 5: Game Day, The Hunt, Cleaning Up, Sentencing
Rename them into ~/Downloads/Wire Season 01/ as 'The Wire - s01eXX.mkv'. Note: I already renamed some files earlier — s01e01.mkv and s01e02.mkv already exist in the destination.

evals.prompt:
I ripped Star Trek TNG Season 2. Files are in ~/Downloads/ in folders named 'Star Trek- The Next Generation Season 2 Disc 1' through 'Star Trek- The Next Generation Season 2 Disc 5'. The files inside use the folder name as a prefix, e.g. 'Star Trek- The Next Generation Season 2 Disc 1_t03.mkv' — they don't start at t00 on every disc. Episode listing:
Disc 1: The Child, Where Silence Has Lease, Elementary Dear Data, The Outrageous Okona, Loud as a Whisper
Disc 2: The Schizoid Man, Unnatural Selection, A Matter of Honor, The Measure of a Man
Disc 3: The Dauphin, Contagion, The Royale, Time Squared, The Icarus Factor
Disc 4: Pen Pals, Q Who, Samaritan Snare, Up the Long Ladder, Manhunt
Disc 5: The Emissary, Peak Performance, Shades of Gray
Rename into ~/Downloads/Season 02/ as 'Star Trek The Next Generation - s02eXX.mkv'.
evals.expected_output: Skill should handle the non-standard filename prefix (show name + disc number, not 'title_') and non-zero starting track numbers. After filtering by size, it must explicitly list any files that were excluded as under 200MB (menus/featurettes) — e.g. Disc 2's t00 and t02, Disc 5's t01–t04 — so gaps in track numbering are explained. It should calculate the median across all 22 episode files, find no multi-episode outliers, build a 22-episode rename plan, run the conflict check, batch all 22 moves into a single bash script, and after completing all moves run rmdir on each disc folder (removing the ones that are now empty). Final ls of the destination should show s02e01 through s02e22.
